heart_disease_feature_unlearning.description: Semi-synthetic heart-disease feature-unlearning verification: the removed target feature should still be detected through indirect mediated influence.

target_rank.description: Rank of the unlearned target feature under the evaluated causal influence ordering.

rank_score.description: Normalized reward for ranking the residual-influence target near the top.

indirect_detected.description: Indicator that residual mediated influence remains visible after direct unlearning.

direct_unlearned.description: Constraint indicator that the target's direct effect remains small.

fuzzing_agreement.description: Indicator that the fast estimator remains consistent with causal fuzzing on the target effect.

query_ratio_vs_fuzzing.description: Machine-independent query-count advantage over causal fuzzing, capped by the train/test evaluators.

performance_feature_unlearning.description: Semi-synthetic performance feature-unlearning verification: the removed protected feature should be detected through indirect paths while direct influence remains small.

target_rank.description: Rank of the unlearned protected feature under the evaluated causal influence ordering.

rank_score.description: Normalized reward for ranking the residual-influence target near the top.

indirect_detected.description: Indicator that residual mediated influence remains visible after direct unlearning.

direct_unlearned.description: Constraint indicator that the target's direct effect remains small.

fuzzing_agreement.description: Indicator that the fast estimator remains consistent with causal fuzzing on the target effect.

query_ratio_vs_fuzzing.description: Machine-independent query-count advantage over causal fuzzing, capped by the train/test evaluators.

heart_disease_subgroup_unlearning.description: Subgroup unlearning analysis on Heart-Disease: indirect mediated influence should differ across age groups even when direct effects are similar.

direct_gap_abs.description: Absolute direct-effect gap between the two Heart-Disease age subgroups.

direct_gap_small.description: Constraint indicator that subgroup disparity is not explained by a large direct-effect gap.

indirect_gap.description: Magnitude of the mediated-effect gap between the two age subgroups.

indirect_gap_detected.description: Indicator that the evaluator detects subgroup-specific mediated residual influence.

total_gap.description: Magnitude of the total-effect gap between the two age subgroups.

total_gap_detected.description: Indicator that total subgroup influence differs after accounting for mediated paths.
